camel_example: aliyun drds UpdateInstanceNetwork --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds000000 --SrcInstanceNetworkType classic
description_en: Switches the network type of a DRDS instance by calling the UpdateInstanceNetwork operation
description_zh: 调用UpdateInstanceNetwork接口切换DRDS实例的网络类型
kebab_example: aliyun drds update-instance-network --drds-instance-id drds000000 --src-instance-network-type classic --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateInstanceNetwork

parameters.help_en:
The current network type of the DRDS instance. Valid values:
vpc: virtual private cloud (VPC)
classic: classic network
parameters.help_zh:
DRDS实例当前的网络类型，取值范围如下：
vpc：专有网络
classic：经典网络
parameters.name: src_instance_network_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to retain the classic network endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 是否保留经典网络地址
parameters.name: retain_classic

parameters.help_en: The number of days for classic network address reservation
parameters.help_zh: 经典网络地址保留天数
parameters.name: classic_expired_days
